notes: SHIPS (Solar Hidden Photon Search) is a helioscope experiment searching for transversely polarised hidden photons (paraphotons) with ~3 eV energies emitted from the Sun. The experiment analyzed 330 hours of solar tracking data and 330 hours of background characterisation, finding no signal. The exclusion limit on kinetic mixing χ as a function of hidden photon mass m is extracted from Figure 13 (the primary exclusion plot). Data points are approximate readings from the SHIPS exclusion curve in the figure. The paper reports a photon detection rate limit of 25 mHz/m² at 95% C.L. The constraint is most stringent for transverse-mode hidden photons in the meV to eV mass range. The paper notes that XENON10 and solar precision tests provide stronger constraints on longitudinally-polarised HPs, but SHIPS provides the most restrictive experimental exclusion limits in the transverse-mode. | selector: figure (sole candidate)
